# Hangup Portal - Comprehensive HR Management System Analysis

## Project Introduction

**Hangup Portal** is a comprehensive Human Resource Management (HRM) desktop application built with Electron, Express.js, and Supabase. The system serves as a complete HR solution for call center operations, managing employee lifecycle, attendance tracking, payroll processing, sales performance, and organizational management.

### Purpose Statement
The application provides a unified platform for HR operations, replacing legacy Google Sheets-based systems with a modern, secure, and scalable desktop application that supports multi-company environments and role-based access control.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Unified HR Management**: Centralize all HR operations from employee onboarding to offboarding
- **Payroll Processing**: Automated salary calculations with complex business rules
- **Attendance Tracking**: Fingerprint integration and automated attendance validation
- **Sales Performance**: Track agent sales metrics and commission calculations
- **Multi-Company Support**: Handle multiple company structures with data isolation
- **Role-Based Access Control**: Granular permissions for different user roles

### Target Audience
- HR managers and administrators
- Team leaders and operations managers  
- Finance and payroll departments
- IT support teams
- Quality assurance teams
- Executive management

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a hybrid architecture combining desktop application capabilities with web-based UI components:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Electron Main Process] --> B[Express Server]
    B --> C[API Routes Layer]
    C --> D[Business Logic Layer]
    D --> E[Data Access Layer]
    E --> F[(Supabase Database)]
    
    G[Browser Window] --> H[Static HTML/CSS/JS]
    H --> I[Frontend JavaScript Modules]
    I --> J[API Client]
    J --> B
    
    K[IPC Bridge] --> L[System Integration]
    A --> K
    
    M[File System] --> N[Local Cache]
    O[Dropbox API] --> P[Attachment Storage]
```

### Component Breakdown

**Desktop Layer (Electron)**
- Main process manages application lifecycle and system integration
- Browser window hosts the web-based UI
- IPC bridge enables secure communication between processes
- File system access for exports and local caching

**Server Layer (Express.js)**
- RESTful API endpoints for all business operations
- Session management and authentication middleware
- Role-based authorization enforcement
- Request validation and error handling

**Business Logic Layer**
- Modular domain-specific modules (attendance, payroll, sales, etc.)
- Complex calculation engines for payroll and commissions
- Validation and business rule enforcement
- Data transformation and mapping utilities

**Data Layer**
- Supabase PostgreSQL database with Row Level Security (RLS)
- Local SQLite cache for offline functionality
- Dropbox integration for file attachments
- Backup and restore capabilities

### Design Patterns

**Repository Pattern**: Data access abstraction through repository modules
**Strategy Pattern**: Pluggable backend implementations (Supabase vs legacy sheets)
**Factory Pattern**: Dynamic module loading based on configuration
**Observer Pattern**: Real-time updates and notifications
**Command Pattern**: Undo/redo functionality for critical operations

- Electron main process initialization
- Express server startup on localhost port 3847

- System tray and window lifecycle management

- Separate Express server for backup operations
- Isolated session management
- Dedicated API routes for backup/restore functionality

- Employee attendance record management
- Working day calculations and month skeleton generation
- Lateness deduction calculations with tiered penalties
